proof_summary: The proof establishes the stronger termwise divisibility by comparing prime-adic valuations: for every prime other than $3$, Kummer carry counts at each prime power and a residue argument force any denominator contribution to be matched by a carry in one of the four numerator binomial coefficients. The prime $3$ is handled separately using Legendre’s ternary digit-sum formula and $2n-1\mid\binom{2n}{n}$; summing the termwise multiples then gives the desired divisibility.
